Profile.bio: Lead Instructor and CodeQuest Community Architect. Ask me about algorithms and system design!
Aspiring Full Stack Engineer. Love Python, React, and solving daily challenges.
Algorithms enthusiast & competitive programmer. Working through Graph Theory.
Building distributed backends with Go and Node.js.
Frontend UI/UX fanatic. Making pixel-perfect animations.
Data Science & Machine Learning learner. Python all day.
First year CS major. Grinding arrays and strings.
Open source contributor in training. Learning React & TypeScript.
Web design hobbyist turned coder. Loving CSS grid & JS.
Started coding 2 weeks ago! Having fun on CodeQuest.
Hello! I'm Jordan Coder, excited to code and level up on CodeQuest!

Challenge.title: Valid Palindrome
Challenge.description: Given a string s, determine if it is a palindrome, considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases.
Challenge.inputFormat: A single line containing the string s

examples.input: A man a plan a canal Panama

starterCode.python:
import sys, re
s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
clean = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "", s).lower()
print("true" if clean == clean[::-1] else "false")

Challenge.title: Fibonacci Number
Challenge.description: Compute the nth Fibonacci number where F(0)=0, F(1)=1, and F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2).
Challenge.inputFormat: A single integer n

starterCode.python:
import sys
n = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
if n <= 1: print(n)
else:
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(2, n + 1): a, b = b, a + b
    print(b)

Challenge.title: Binary Search
Challenge.description: Given a sorted array of distinct integers nums and a target value, return its index if found, or -1 if not found.
Challenge.inputFormat:
Line 1: space-separated integers
Line 2: target integer

starterCode.python:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split("\n")
nums = list(map(int, lines[0].split()))
target = int(lines[1])
l, r, ans = 0, len(nums) - 1, -1
while l <= r:
    m = (l + r) // 2
    if nums[m] == target: ans = m; break
    elif nums[m] < target: l = m + 1
    else: r = m - 1
print(ans)

Challenge.title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
Challenge.description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.
Challenge.inputFormat: Single line of space-separated integers

starterCode.python:
import sys
nums = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().strip().split()))
max_so_far = curr = nums[0]
for x in nums[1:]:
    curr = max(x, curr + x)
    max_so_far = max(max_so_far, curr)
print(max_so_far)

Quiz.description: Test your understanding of JSX, state immutability, useEffect dependencies, and keys.

QuizQuestion.question: What is the output of type(5 / 2) in Python 3?
QuizQuestion.explanation: In Python 3, single slash division always returns a float.

QuizQuestion.question: Which built-in type in Python is mutable?
QuizQuestion.explanation: Lists can be modified in-place; tuples and strings are immutable.

QuizQuestion.question: What does the "pass" keyword do in Python?
options: Acts as a null placeholder statement
QuizQuestion.explanation: pass is an explicit no-op placeholder.

QuizQuestion.question: How do you define a function in Python?
QuizQuestion.explanation: Python uses the "def" keyword.

QuizQuestion.question: Which dictionary method retrieves a value without raising a KeyError if absent?
QuizQuestion.explanation: dict.get(key) returns None (or default) if key not present.

QuizQuestion.question: What is the average time complexity of searching in a Hash Table?
QuizQuestion.explanation: Hash tables offer O(1) average lookup assuming a well-distributed hash function.

QuizQuestion.question: Which data structure follows the Last-In First-Out (LIFO) principle?
QuizQuestion.explanation: Stacks operate strictly on LIFO.

QuizQuestion.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
QuizQuestion.explanation: QuickSort degrades to O(n^2) when poor pivots are repeatedly chosen.

QuizQuestion.question: In a balanced Binary Search Tree, what is the search complexity?
QuizQuestion.explanation: Balanced BST search takes logarithmic time O(log n).

QuizQuestion.question: Which keyword creates a block-scoped variable that cannot be reassigned?
QuizQuestion.explanation: const creates a block-scoped read-only reference.

QuizQuestion.question: What is the return value of typeof NaN in JavaScript?
QuizQuestion.explanation: In JavaScript specification, NaN is of type "number".

QuizQuestion.question: Which method returns a new array with elements that pass a test?
QuizQuestion.explanation: filter() creates a shallow copy containing only matching elements.

QuizQuestion.question: Why must list items in React have unique "key" props?
options: To help React identify which items have changed, been added, or removed
QuizQuestion.explanation: Keys help React efficiently reconcile and update the DOM.

QuizQuestion.question: When does a useEffect hook with an empty dependency array [] run?
QuizQuestion.explanation: An empty dependency array causes the effect to run once after the initial render.
